Ingredient.title: Ingredient
Ingredient.description: Represents an ingredient used in recipes.

packageQuantity.description: Quantity of the ingredient in a package.

packageUnit.description: Unit of measure for the ingredient (e.g., g, ml, unit).

RecipeItem.title: Recipe Item
RecipeItem.description: Represents a single ingredient within a recipe, capturing its quantity and unit.

id.description: Unique identifier for the recipe item.

ingredientId.description: Reference to the original ingredient ID.

ingredientName.description: Name of the ingredient at the time of saving.

displayQuantity.description: The quantity used, as displayed in the UI.

displayUnit.description: The unit of measure used, as displayed in the UI (e.g., xicara).

baseQuantity.description: The quantity converted to the ingredient's base unit (g, ml, un).

Recipe.title: Recipe
Recipe.description: Represents a recipe with its ingredients and financial parameters. Costs and sale prices are calculated dynamically at runtime.

name.description: Name of the recipe (e.g., Chocolate Cake).

createdAt.description: Date when the recipe was created (ISO 8601 format).

items.description: List of ingredient items that make up the recipe.

variableCostsPercentage.description: Percentage of variable costs associated with the recipe.

packagingCost.description: Cost of packaging for the recipe.

profitMargin.description: Profit margin percentage for the recipe.

isFrosting.description: Indicates if this recipe is a frosting or filling.

frostingId.description: The ID of another recipe to be used as a frosting.

definition.description: Stores ingredient data specific to a user. All ingredients are owned by the user. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user who owns the ingredient.

definition.description: Stores recipe data specific to a user. All recipes are owned by the user. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The ID of the user who owns the recipe.
